title: SANTA wire-tier actuals
description: A runner's output for one wire vector: an object mapping each entry's name to { bytes_hex, error }. Success: the runner's reserialization (lower-case hex) + error null. Otherwise bytes_hex null + an outcome tag. A single round-trip verdict; no cost dimension. Companion to docs/specs/wire-tier.md.

error.description: null = round-tripped to bytes; 'errored' = parse/reserialize threw; 'not-implemented' = no serializer for this kind; 'unrepresentable' = has the kind, can't hold this value.

allOf.$comment: error null => bytes_hex non-null (the reserialization); any non-null tag => bytes_hex null.
